submitted.rationale: La–Sb oxides have wide band gaps, so little photoresponse is expected under 2.4 eV light. I spread the 5 EQE measurements across the line (Sb fraction 0.12, 0.26, 0.36, 0.51, 0.68). Every value was near zero; only index 16 (Sb 0.36) gave a positive EQE (0.0047%), so it is the best measured.
